name: Terrarium 45x40x70
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 45x40x70 cm. Volume: 126.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 45x40x70 cm terrarium has a floor of 1800 cm² and about 126 liters. Without a 3D background the whole 40 cm depth is free, so thicker branches and larger plants fit inside than in narrower models. The 70 cm height places it among the vertical terrariums.

A pair of crested geckos has enough room here to pass each other, with two feeders at different heights. A gargoyle gecko needs the odd thick, horizontal branch. Green anoles and day geckos use the upper third, where the lamp is. Tree frogs choose the damper lower part, so it is good for the substrate to be deeper and planted with live plants.

The outer film on three sides replaces a background and gives the animals cover, and you choose the pattern from the 34 on offer. If you want relief, look at the 45x35x80 with a 3D background. We ship it by courier to your address. If you need 10 cm more or less height, we complete such a change in 7 to 14 days.
